title: Trading Scope for Credibility in Difference-in-Differences
abstract: arXiv:2608.16867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When parallel trends fails for some treated cohorts but not others, the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT), an average over all of them, is exactly the target that becomes hard to recover. We propose changing the estimand rather than defending it. The credible-subpopulation local ATT (LATT) is the effect for the subpopulation of cohorts whose parallel trends is credible, and it is point-identified under parallel trends for the selected cohorts alone, a weaker requirement that can hold when the ATT's fails. It is estimated by reweighting standard group-time effects toward those cohorts, and paired with honest sensitivity bounds on the residual violation that a pre-trend screen cannot rule out. The method's advantage grows with how informative pre-trends are about post-treatment violations, as simulations confirm. In an application, a significantly positive pooled estimate of the shale boom's effect on local house prices proves

translated_title: 在差分中的差分法中，以可信度换取范围
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16867v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当平行趋势假设对某些处理组群体成立而对其他群体不成立时，处理组的平均处理效应（ATT），即所有群体的平均值，恰恰成为难以恢复的目标。我们提议改变估计目标而非为其辩护。可信子群体的局部平均处理效应（LATT）是针对平行趋势可信的群体子集的效应，它仅在所选群体的平行趋势假设下即可点识别，这是一个比ATT失效条件更弱的要求。通过重新加权标准群体-时间效应以偏向这些群体来估计，并配以对预趋势筛选无法排除的残余违背的诚实敏感性界限。该方法的优势随着预趋势对处理后违背信息量的增加而增长，模拟结果证实了这一点。在一项应用中，页岩繁荣对当地房价影响的显著正向汇总估计证明了这一点。
tldr: 本文提出在平行趋势假设部分失效时，通过聚焦于可信子群体并估计局部平均处理效应（LATT），以更弱假设换取估计的可靠性和诚实敏感性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes focusing on credible subpopulations to estimate a local average treatment effect (LATT) under weaker parallel trends assumptions, trading scope for reliability with honest sensitivity bounds.
